summary: Native conversations load full clipped tool output on explicit block actions or stui's expand-all for visible clipped blocks; viewport-visible images load automatically in memory on the phone and in stui when terminal graphics are supported.

replay.detail: Conversation views use the existing owner-native content chunk route for explicit full-output reads and automatic viewport-visible image reads; no claims are replayed or projections rebuilt.

schema.detail: No database schema, migrations or generated client wire fields change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or fleet coordination rules change.

compatibility.detail: Clients reuse conversation-blocks.v1 continuation refs and conversation-content-chunk responses. Continuation byte sizes describe the original owner value rather than its clipped display preview.

downtime.detail: No coordinated outage or API interruption is required.

manual.detail: No configuration change is required. Full tool output loads on an explicit per-block action or stui's o expand-all for visible clipped blocks. Images load automatically when visible: stui requires terminal graphics support, and the phone serializes reads through a viewport queue.

recovery.detail: Expanded JSON, image bytes and inline rendering data remain in memory only; no new stored state or rollback procedure is introduced.
